job.question: According to the Monroe County deferred compensation services RFP, how many participants did the plan have and what were its total assets?
job.expected_facts: As of December 31, 2022: 4,398 plan participants and plan assets of $308,676,730. In addition, the OBRA part-time seasonal plan had 536 participants with assets of $926,785.
job.acceptance: Main plan 4,398 participants / $308,676,730 is sufficient. OBRA 536 / $926,785 is supplementary and must not replace or be silently added to main-plan figures.

reviews.reason: This is a 2020 City of Temple City RFP, not the Monroe County deferred compensation services RFP. Its participant and asset figures concern a different plan and date, so it cannot support the requested facts.
quotes: City of Temple City, California 457 Deferred Compensation Plan Request for Proposals for Plan Administration and Record Keeping Services

The Plan as of March 31, 2020 had 31 actively contributing participants and 15 non-active participants for a total of 46 participants with a balance. Total assets as of this time period were $1,894,729.
